text:
Carmen: Heads-up: visitor from LocalBake delivering a cake + an extra box (might be a small monitor?) around 3:10pm. Need temp badge + a spot in the office fridge for the cake. Also request a high-top table by the cafe for tasting while they sign paperwork. :cake: :framed_picture: :chair:
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 1x cake (LocalBake), 1x small boxed item (label unknown). Location: Receiving A. Temp badge color: sky. Fridge slots available: 2. High-top by cafe status: maybe occupied.
Dmitri: I use the high-top at 3pm for 10 mins usually. Happy to move if needed. :thumbsup:
Lena: Can we avoid fridge 2 (back) — it's full of experiment samples. Please use Fridge A near kitchen.
Theo: I'll clear a shelf in Fridge A at 3:00. Also if that boxed item is tech, Facilities can help unload.
Avery: Quick poll: react :thumbsup: to reserve high-top 3:05-3:30, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Dmitri: :thumbsup:
Carmen: Note from vendor: cake contains nuts. Can we add an allergen sticky on the box and inform concierge?
FrontDeskBot: Temp badge color set to sky. Delivery flagged: "contains nuts". Fridge spot reserved in Fridge A. High-top reservation requested. Facilities notified for possible help 3:05.
Lena: Thanks for the allergen note. I'll put a sign on the high-top: "Vendor tasting 3:05-3:30 please avoid".
Theo: Shelf cleared in Fridge A. Facilities confirmed ETA 3:00.
Avery: I'll meet them at concierge and escort to the high-top. I'll also bring a small plate and napkins. :plate_with_cutlery:
Carmen: Perfect. FrontDeskBot, please set visitor log to require ID scan and print sky badge.
FrontDeskBot: Done  ID scan required, sky temp badge printed on arrival, delivery log updated with allergen note and fridge allocation.
_meta: watercooler thread coordinating a vendor cake delivery, fridge allocation, allergen notice, temporary badge, and seating reservation
